Class AetherisNotebookPanel.CellCard

java.lang.Object
java.awt.Component
java.awt.Container
javax.swing.JComponent
javax.swing.JPanel
org.aetheris.swing.AetherisNotebookPanel.CellCard
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImageObserver, MenuContainer, Serializable, Accessible
Enclosing class:
AetherisNotebookPanel
private final class AetherisNotebookPanel.CellCard extends JPanel
The class CellCard is one turn on the canvas. The card holds the cell record, the prompt, the reply, the collapse button, and the header. The four marks are included, excluded, input-only, and output-only. The burner box stores whether the turn is ephemeral. A cell that is not readable shows load error and a disabled ?. That card cannot be expanded, edited, or sent. A readable card shows the marks, the fold button, Expanded View, burner, View, and Copy. Model is added when the cell is not a merge sink. Add Cell is added when the cell is a merge sink. The group row starts hidden. A collapsed card shows a one-line brief instead of the prompt and the reply. An open card that is not a merge sink shows the prompt and the reply in a vertical split. An open merge sink shows only the reply. The reply area is not editable. An excluded cell paints the prompt and the reply in gray.

  • Constructor Details

    • CellCard

      private CellCard(CellRecord cell)
      The constructor builds the card for cell. The gaps are 4 pixels. The theme paints the card, and the card registers for hover text. A cell that is not readable returns after a 360 by 48 preferred size. The maximum height of that card is 48, and the maximum width comes from cardMaxWidth(). A readable collapsed card builds the brief row and calls fitCollapsedCard(). A readable open merge sink adds only the reply scroll and calls applyOpenHeight(). A readable open member builds the prompt and reply split, seats the quiet bar, and calls applyOpenHeight(). The split starts with equal resize weight, and its border is cleared. paintChrome() runs again after the body is added. installReplyFit() and installImportPopup(Component) run for every readable card. An unreadable card also installs the import popup.
      Parameters:
      cell - The cell is the turn this card shows.

  • Method Details

    • paintChrome

      private void paintChrome()
      The method paintChrome paints the card edge. An excluded cell starts at dark gray. Any other cell starts at #3A3A3A. A pin that is on, and a readable cell, uses the green edge when the cell matches the pin words. That same pin uses #222222 when the cell misses a word. The focused cell uses the sapphire edge. A card in the armed merge cell's group also uses the sapphire edge. The border is the rounded edge at the cell thickness, corner, and pad.

    • litWithMerge

      private boolean litWithMerge()
      The method litWithMerge reports whether the armed card is this group's merge cell. A null group id returns false. An empty group id returns false. A focused cell that is not a merge sink returns false. The same group id returns true.
      Returns:
      The return value is true when the armed card is this group's merge cell.

    • cardMaxWidth

      private int cardMaxWidth()
      The method cardMaxWidth returns the width cap for this card. A card that is not a group member returns Integer.MAX_VALUE, so it can grow with the column. A group member with no header yet returns 480. Any other group member returns groupedMemberWidth().
      Returns:
      The return value is that cap in pixels.

    • groupedMember

      private boolean groupedMember()
      The method groupedMember reports whether this card is a group member. A null group id returns false. An empty group id returns false. A column position that is not greater than 0 returns false. The merge sink stays on the column width because its column position is not greater than 0.
      Returns:
      The return value is true for a group member.

    • groupedMemberWidth

      private int groupedMemberWidth()
      The method groupedMemberWidth measures one group member. The bar width is the header's preferred width, and a width below 1 becomes 1. An open member adds 10 pixels from the toggle to the card's east edge. A collapsed member adds collapsedBriefLane() instead of those 10 pixels. The result also adds the left and right insets.
      Returns:
      The return value is the outer width in pixels.

    • collapsedBriefLane

      private int collapsedBriefLane()
      The method collapsedBriefLane measures the one-line preview on a collapsed member. The lane is 32 widths of the character n, plus 10 pixels to the east. A character width below 1 uses 8.
      Returns:
      The return value is that width in pixels.

    • applyCardWidth

      private void applyCardWidth(int cardH)
      The method applyCardWidth stores the card's preferred, maximum, and minimum size. The height of each size is cardH. A member uses the measured width for all three. A card whose cap is Integer.MAX_VALUE prefers 400 pixels, has a minimum width of 20, and keeps that maximum. That card can still grow with the column.
      Parameters:
      cardH - The height is the outer card height in pixels.

    • noteCellEdit

      private void noteCellEdit(DocumentEvent event)
      The method noteCellEdit records one prompt insert or removal. A null prompt area returns without a record. A null event returns without a record. A memory that is applying an undo returns without a record, so the stack does not record the write it just applied. An insert reads the new text, and a bad location returns without a record. A removal reads the previous text, and a bad offset or length returns without a record. A removal that runs past the previous text is cut to that text. Any other event type returns without a record. Paste, cut, and a deleted character take this same path. The span stores the caret from before Swing stepped the dot when the dot is already past the new text. An insert whose dot is still inside the new text stores the current dot and a dot after the insert. An insert whose dot is before the change stores the change itself. A removal whose dot is past the deleted text keeps the current dot and a dot before the deletion. Any other removal stores the current dot and the removal offset. A span the memory refuses returns without a post. A span that is due to fold calls AetherisNotebookPanel.scheduleUndoFold(String). noteLiveDraft() writes the cell text and posts the edit. This method does not count tokens itself. The posted edit is what the heat bar reads on its beat. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md FINESSE:f-171 // @aa-sdd GK-0563 aetheris-plan-f-189.001.md FINESSE:f-189 // @aa-sdd GK-0564 aetheris-plan-f-203.001.md FINESSE:f-203
      Parameters:
      event - The event is the document change.

    • noteLiveDraft

      private void noteLiveDraft()
      The method noteLiveDraft writes the prompt onto the cell and posts the token edit. liveTokenHold returns without a write, so a post cannot reenter. A null prompt area returns without a write. A null memory text is stored as an empty string. A null cell id, or an id that is not the focused cell, calls armFocus(boolean) with true. The focused cell calls AetherisNotebookPanel.offerTokenEdit(String) and AetherisNotebookPanel.scheduleInspectorView(). The hold flag is cleared before the method returns, including when the post throws.

    • armFocus

      private void armFocus()
      The method armFocus remembers the previous card for Join and arms this card. The call is armFocus(boolean) with false, so the click measures now.

    • armFocus

      private void armFocus(boolean deferMeasure)
      The method armFocus arms this card. The previous focused id is stored for Join. This cell becomes the focused id. The previous card and this card repaint their edges. The delete button and the status line refresh. A true deferMeasure posts the token edit and schedules the inspector. A false deferMeasure calls AetherisNotebookPanel.refreshInspector() now. The cell caption is repainted in both cases.
      Parameters:
      deferMeasure - The flag is true when a draft key posts the edit instead of measuring now.

    • repaintArmedChrome

      private void repaintArmedChrome(String cellId)
      The method repaintArmedChrome repaints the edge of the armed card. A null cellId returns without a paint. A merge cell paints every card in that group. A null canvas returns without a paint in that case. A card that is not mounted is skipped. A cell that is not a merge sink paints only its own card.
      Parameters:
      cellId - The id is the card that was armed or is armed now.

    • applyOpenHeight

      private void applyOpenHeight()
      The method applyOpenHeight sizes an open prompt and reply. A null reply scroll returns without a change. A null reply area returns without a change. A saved row count below 1 uses 1. A font height below 16 uses 16. The bounded height is the row count times that line, plus 8. An unchecked reply uses that bounded height. A checked reply in a group grows to the wrapped buffer when that buffer is taller. A checked reply outside a group uses the wrapped buffer when that buffer is greater than 0. A checked reply outside a group sets the area rows to 1 and hides both reply scroll bars. Any other reply keeps the saved row count and shows scroll bars as needed. The prompt, when present, uses the bounded height and shows scroll bars as needed. The card height adds the header, the divider when a prompt exists, both pane heights, and 20. appliedReplyH stores the reply height. A body split is reset to its preferred sizes.

    • lockPane

      private void lockPane(JScrollPane scroll, int paneH)
      The method lockPane locks one scroll pane to a height. The preferred width is 200 and the preferred height is paneH. The maximum width is Integer.MAX_VALUE and the maximum height is paneH. The minimum width is 20 and the minimum height is paneH. Text that is taller than paneH scrolls inside the pane.
      Parameters:
      scroll - The scroll is the pane to lock.
      paneH - The height is the locked height in pixels.

    • replyContentHeight

      private int replyContentHeight()
      The method replyContentHeight measures the wrapped reply. The width is the viewport width, then the scroll width, then this card's width. A width below 40 returns 0, which means the pane has no width yet. An inner width below 40 returns 0. A missing UI returns 0. A missing root view returns 0. Otherwise the root view is sized to the inner width and an unbounded height. The result adds the area insets, the scroll insets, and one line of slack. A result shorter than one line plus those insets and that slack is raised to that floor. A line height below 16 uses 16.
      Returns:
      The return value is the height in pixels, or 0 when the pane has no width yet.

    • installReplyFit

      private void installReplyFit()
      The method installReplyFit listens for reply edits and for a resize. A collapsed card returns without a listener. A null reply area returns without a listener. A null reply scroll returns without a listener. An insert, a removal, an attribute change, and a resize each call queueReplyFit(). queueReplyFit() also runs once at the end.

    • queueReplyFit

      private void queueReplyFit()
      The method queueReplyFit fits a checked reply after the current layout pass. A cell that is not in Expanded View returns without a fit. A collapsed cell returns without a fit. The fit runs later on the event thread. That later run returns when the reply area is null, the cell is collapsed, or Expanded View is off. Otherwise it calls refitOpenCard().

    • refitOpenCard

      private void refitOpenCard()
      The method refitOpenCard applies the open height and lets the parents pick it up. fitting returns without a second entry. A collapsed cell returns without a fit. A null reply scroll or a null reply area returns without a fit. applyOpenHeight() and liftMemberRow() run while fitting is true. fitting is cleared before the height is compared, including when those calls throw. A reply height that is still before returns without a revalidate. A changed height revalidates this card, invalidates each parent, and revalidates the immediate parent.

    • brief

      private JTextArea brief(boolean ghost, boolean hasResponse)
      The method brief builds the one-line preview east of the button bar. The text starts at the first character of the reply and keeps one row. A line height below 1 uses 16. The area is not editable and does not wrap. An excluded card uses gray. A card with a reply uses the output yellow. A card with no reply uses the response gray. The caret color is the field background. The preferred and minimum width are 20, and the maximum width is unbounded. The height is one line plus 8. Hover shows the cell line from AetherisNotebookPanel.stampLine(CellRecord).

      hasResponse - The flag is true when reply text is present.

      private void appendPoolChunk(String text)
      The method appendPoolChunk appends one pool chunk onto the visible reply. A null chunk returns without a change. An empty chunk returns without a change. A mounted reply area turns yellow, appends the chunk, and moves the caret to the end. Copy is enabled when that area's trimmed text is not empty. That path returns without touching the brief. A collapsed brief, when the reply area is absent, turns yellow, appends the chunk, and moves its caret to the end. This method does not write the stored reply.

      text - The text is the chunk.

    • paintCellMark

      private void paintCellMark()
      The method paintCellMark paints the four marks and the excluded colors from cell.state. The button whose stored state is the cell state sets aetheris.cellmark.seated to true. Each other mark sets that property to false. Every mark is repainted. An excluded prompt or reply is gray. An included prompt uses the input green. A reply with text uses the output yellow, and a reply without text uses the response gray. The brief uses those same reply colors. paintChrome() and paintPaneEdges() run, and the card repaints. The deck is not rebuilt.

    • installImportPopup

      private void installImportPopup(Component node)
      The method installImportPopup adds the import menu listener to one component. The listener calls armFocus() on a press. If cellMarkHit(Component) is true, the listener calls showImportPopup(MouseEvent) and returns. If barHit(Component) is true, the listener calls AetherisNotebookPanel.focusCanvas(Component). If this cell has a non-empty group id, a press that is not targetHit(Component) asks the text pane for the caret. If that grouped press has no text pane, the listener calls focusGroupCell(). If this cell has no group id, the listener asks the text pane for the caret. If that lone press has no text pane and is not targetHit(Component), the listener calls AetherisNotebookPanel.focusCanvas(Component). A press that did not return on the cell mark then calls showImportPopup(MouseEvent). The listener calls showImportPopup(MouseEvent) on a release. If node is a container, the method calls itself on each child.
      Parameters:
      node - The node is the component that receives the listener.

    • showImportPopup

      private void showImportPopup(MouseEvent e)
      The method showImportPopup opens the cell menu for a popup trigger. If the event is not a popup trigger, the method returns. If assistantHit(Component) is true, AetherisNotebookPanel.Host.aetherisStatus(String) shows import refused on output. If the pointer is not on the reply, the menu adds Import.... That item calls beginImport(). If the cell group id is non-empty, the menu adds Duplicate group. That item calls AetherisNotebookPanel.duplicateGroup(). If the menu already has an item, a separator is added. The menu then adds Transfer Conversation. That item calls AetherisNotebookPanel.transferFromCanvas(). SshClientTheme.applyPopup(JPopupMenu) paints the menu. The menu opens at the event point on the event component.
      Parameters:
      e - The event is the mouse event that may be a popup trigger.

    • beginImport

      private void beginImport()
      The method beginImport reads a chosen file into this turn's prompt. If AetherisNotebookPanel.mergeSink(CellRecord) is true, AetherisNotebookPanel.Host.aetherisStatus(String) shows import refused: merge cell and the method returns. If the cell state is CellState.OUTPUT_ONLY, the status shows import refused: output only and the method returns. AetherisNotebookPanel.Host.chooseRememberedFile(Component) supplies the file. If that file is absent, the method returns. A length greater than 1,024 times 1,024 bytes marks the file as large. If reading the length fails, showImportError(Throwable) runs and the method returns. If the file is large, the status shows This file is large. The import continues. and the read still runs. The worker calls readPromptStream(File). If that text is absent, the Swing thread shows import refused: binary. If the text is present, the cell prompt and the prompt area both become that text. AetherisNotebookPanel.persistQuiet(CellRecord) stores the cell. The success status is imported into turn plus the turn index. If the file was large, that status starts with This file is large. The import continues. AetherisNotebookPanel.refreshInspector() runs after a successful import. If the worker fails, showImportError(Throwable) runs.

    • showImportError

      private void showImportError(Throwable ex)
      The method showImportError opens the import failure slide. A null throwable starts with an empty message. If the message is null or empty and the throwable is null, the message becomes import failed. If the message is null or empty and the throwable is present, the message becomes the simple class name. The slide text is import failed: plus that message. The second argument to AetherisNotebookPanel.showErrorSlide(String) is false, so the slide is not yellow.
      Parameters:
      ex - The throwable is the failure, and it may be null.

    • readPromptStream

      private String readPromptStream(File file) throws IOException
      The method readPromptStream reads a file as UTF-8 prompt text. The stream is a buffered file stream. The method reads up to 8,192 bytes into a sample. If hasNul(byte[]) is true for that sample, the method returns null. Bytes after the sample are copied without another zero-byte test. The sample and the rest of the file go into one buffer. A later read of zero bytes stops the copy. A later read below zero also stops the copy. The buffer becomes a string in UTF-8. An empty file returns an empty string. The stream is closed in a finally block. An IOException from close is ignored.
      Parameters:
      file - The file is the chosen prompt file.
      Returns:
      The return value is the UTF-8 text, or null when the sample contains a zero byte.
      Throws:
      IOException - The method throws IOException when the file cannot be opened or read.

    • hasNul

      private boolean hasNul(byte[] data)
      The method hasNul reports whether a sample contains a zero byte. The scan covers the array length or 8,192 bytes, whichever is smaller. If a scanned byte equals 0, the method returns true. If no scanned byte equals 0, the method returns false.
      Parameters:
      data - The data is the sample to scan.
      Returns:
      The return value is true when a zero byte is inside the scanned prefix.
